caption: The video captures a bright studio with white walls, a dark ceiling, track spotlights, an air-conditioning unit, light wood floor, and a large mirror along the right side. A woman with long dark hair stands facing the mirror, wearing a black floral top, black skirt with red trim, red leg warmers, and red shoes. Her front-facing reflection matches her stance and movements. She holds both elbows bent, hands raised near head height. Her arms extend upward, opening her hands above her head. She keeps her arms stretched overhead with open fingers while her feet stay broadly spaced and her weight shifts. She bends her elbows and draws the raised hands down to head level with splayed fingers. She maintains this bent-arm pose with small hand adjustments and a slight sway of the torso and hips. The mirror continues to reproduce every change as the fixed camera records the body movement throughout the excerpt.
